correctness.rationale: Exact active-constraint connectivity classifies every polar vertex, with a fully justified converse; a strict norm-comparison screens equal-sign and undersaturated-smaller-blade vertices. The strictly concave integer quadratic gives the full bound and all boundary ties. Symmetry converts central inradius into global inradius. Finite-facet slack plus explicit contact-normal rank computations determine the full optimal-center affine hull. A standalone exact-integer checker has been replayed on 2,176,596 polar candidates and 1,485 additional integer profiles; these checks supplement the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Natural first unequal two-clique extension of the equal-blade windmill; the theorem describes a previously missing sharp switch from full-blade to partly occupied facet normals and a large drop in affine dimension of the full optimal-center set. These are geometric invariants not implied by the established total-facet one-sum formula, with a reusable structural screening proof. The threshold and parity alternation give motivated information across an infinite family, not a small arbitrary numerical slice.
